name: Halo Frame
description: A frame that puts a slowly turning gradient ring and a soft halo around one child.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of the conic gradient, in order. The first is repeated at the end to close the circle.

props.name: animate
props.description: Turn the gradient. It holds still under reduced motion.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the halo, from 0 to 1.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Width of the ring in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Outer corner radius in pixels. The child's corners are set to this minus the ring width.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: One child with its own surface, such as a bg-card panel. Its corners are rounded to sit inside the ring.
